thread:
incident-bot: PagerDuty triggered: PAGER-3421 -> High 5xx rate on inference-gateway (eu-west1). 5xx: 12% over 5m, latency tail up. Paging sam (on-call). https://pagerduty.example/PD-3421 :rotating_light:

sam: acked. looking now.

sam: @mira can you check kvcache/redis evictions and sidecar logs? pattern looks like cache churn.

mira: on it. pulling metrics — evictions spiked at 16:02 UTC in azb, pod OOMs on kvcache-sidecar there. cpu also climbing on edge-proxy.

leo: noted. preparing a low-risk traffic shift to reduce pressure on azb (20% -> other az). will coordinate with sam.

sam: hold off full shift — that change may affect locality. quick check: any recent deploys in azb?

mira: no deploys in last hour. sidecar version 1.3.2 on azb. seeing repeated `OOMKill` in kube events and this in the sidecar logs:

```
E 16:02:12 kvcache-sidecar: heap: exceeded threshold, freeing buffer
E 16:02:13 kvcache-sidecar: allocate failed, fallback to disk cache
```

mira: suspect mem leak in 1.3.2 with heavy prefix loads.

nina: support: customers reporting elevated error rates — right now 3 active tickets open, but several customers saw intermittent 502/503s. transparency msg prepared.

sam: reassigning PD to mira for mitigation. mira: please ack PD and proceed.

mira: acked. scaling kvcache replicas in azb and restarting sidecars now:

```
kubectl scale deploy kvcache-azb -n prod --replicas=6
kubectl rollout restart deploy kvcache-sidecar-azb -n prod
```

leo: enabling temporary model-route fallback for heavy queries to lower memory pressure: set model-lite weight to 10% for /generate.

sam: note PD escalation timer 10m. if not falling, plan is to divert traffic to dedicated pool.

mira: restarts in progress — evictions dropping in the last 1m window. 5xx down to ~3% now (1m avg).

nina: CS update posted to customers: "we're investigating transient errors; operations underway; no data lost." link: https://status.example/incidents/3421

leo: created GH issue: #875 "kvcache-sidecar mem leak (1.3.2)" and attached logs/graphs.

sam: good. follow-ups: 1) track root cause and ship sidecar patch, 2) add autoscale rule for kvcache on az eviction signal, 3) add runbook note for az fail-over handoff.

mira: agreed. I will keep replicas up for now and monitor for 20m.

sam: we've had 30m stable with 5xx <1% overall and no further OOMs in azb, I'm resolving the PD incident and closing this thread. great job. :thumbsup:

incident-bot: PagerDuty incident PAGER-3421 resolved by sam.
